shared_elements: low-relief motifs arranged in horizontal registers/bands
a row of repeated similar forms across the top of the field
sinuous curving elongated forms (vegetal tendrils vs. snakes)
bilaterally paired elements flanking a central axis
justification: The only correspondences are highly generic: both surfaces carry shallow relief organised into horizontal registers with a row of repeated forms along the top and some paired, axially balanced elements. What is actually depicted is wholly different — A is an all-over symmetrical vegetal composition of palmettes, rosettes, leaves and a knotted cartouche, while B shows a bestiary of schematic animals (quadrupeds, snakes, a large bird, a fox-like creature) with arms and bands, sharing no specific motif or relationship with A.
